entries.0c1bd7f0a475e259: Manufacturers across a wide range of industries in Japan and overseas, including electrical equipment, automobiles and cosmetics
entries.148390b11b636812: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥115,098 million, down 3.9% year on year. While basic chemicals declined, electronic materials grew and functional materials remained at the prior-year level. By customer location, revenue was ¥87,503 million from Japan and ¥12,937 million from China.
entries.19e058c6d2c439d0: Raw materials for refrigeration oil (isononanoic acid, octylic acid)
entries.23bd1ce001a1cea0: With oxo technology, which produces aldehydes from olefins and oxo gas, as its core technology, it manufactures petrochemical products in three fields: functional materials, electronic materials and basic chemicals. Its subsidiary Kurogane Kasei performs contract manufacturing of high-performance organic materials for the electronic information and medical fields.
entries.26585c5bb58fde25: Centered on oxo technology, which produces aldehydes from olefins and oxo gas, it manufactures petrochemical products in functional materials, electronic materials and basic chemicals, and sells them to customers in Japan and overseas, earning revenue from them.
entries.3f057a3d368845d0: A chemicals manufacturer with plants in Yokkaichi and Chiba
entries.460f5f714a5a6a00: It manufactures and sells isononanoic acid (Kyowanoic-N) and octylic acid, which are raw materials for refrigerating machine oil used in air conditioners, freezers and other equipment, and 1, 3-butylene glycol, a raw material for cosmetics and skin care products. The raw materials for refrigerating machine oil are products suited to refrigerants that do not destroy the ozone layer and have a low global warming potential.
entries.644f8e313886ab84: Products are sold to customers in a wide range of industries in Japan and overseas. Its major customer is Idemitsu Kosan Co., Ltd., and its revenue from that company for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥20,107 million. Revenue from Miyako Chemical Co., Ltd. was also ¥11,369 million.
entries.7a7412369ae86d65: The group operates a single segment, the Chemicals Business, whose main activity is the manufacture and sale of various petrochemical products. Its core technology is the “Oxo Technology,” which produces aldehydes from olefins and oxo gas as raw materials, and its main production sites are the Yokkaichi Plant (Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture) and the Chiba Plant (Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture). The company and four subsidiaries and one associate form the group (as of December 31, 2025). Because the reportable segment is only the Chemicals Business, amounts by business field are not given in the descriptions of each field.
entries.8957c00a8787de86: The company cites as its strengths the production technology and know-how it has built up since it began mass production of aldehydes using oxo technology in 1970. In raw materials for refrigeration oil, as a leading company, it cites as strengths its close network with customers, advanced production technology and know-how, globally deployed logistics bases, and stable procurement of raw materials, and says it will expand the business by making maximum use of the production facilities it strengthened in 2024. In electronic materials, it makes full use of quality control know-how to supply high-purity solvents with extremely low metal content.
entries.b01217c391701df3: It manufactures and sells chemicals used across a wide range of industries, including automobiles and housing, such as solvents for paints like butanol and butyl acetate, and octanol and isononyl alcohol (Oxocol 900), which are raw materials for plasticizers.
entries.b98f9278729e773c: It manufactures and sells high-purity solvents (PM-P, PMA-P) used in the production of liquid crystal displays, semiconductors and photoresists.
entries.c1ed08f486bb0a85: A manufacturer that, with oxo technology at its core, produces and sells chemicals such as raw materials for refrigerating machine oil, cosmetic raw materials, and high-purity solvents for semiconductors.
entries.c7568af062b8cd42: It manufactures and sells isononanoic acid (Kyowanoic-N), a raw material for refrigerating machine oil used in air conditioners, freezers and similar equipment, octylic acid, and 1, 3-butylene glycol, a raw material for cosmetics and skin care products, among other products.
entries.d17f85b5fc8cc7c7: Based on the sales results by business field in MD&A (functional materials ¥56,686 million, basic chemicals ¥45,374 million, electronic materials ¥12,309 million, others ¥727 million, and their composition ratios), revenue by region in the segment-related information (Japan ¥87,503 million, China ¥12,937 million, other Asia ¥7,800 million, other regions ¥6,856 million), and information by major customer (Idemitsu Kosan Co., Ltd. ¥20,107 million, Miyako Chemical Co., Ltd. ¥11,369 million).
entries.d75f93321a24f465: The group operates a single segment, the Chemicals Business, whose main activity is the manufacture and sale of various petrochemical products.
entries.d9ce7b0324bcbdd7: KH Neochem Co., Ltd. has its head office in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and its main production sites are the Yokkaichi Plant and the Chiba Plant. The company, four subsidiaries and one associated company make up the group, and consolidated employees number 863 (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.e20e5e7243345bf3: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,799 million, down 6.7% year on year.
entries.e546bf4b1f8ad419: It manufactures and sells high-purity solvents (PM-P, PMA-P) used in the production of liquid crystal displays, semiconductors and photoresists. It supplies solvents with extremely low metal content, using quality control know-how built up over many years.
entries.f3ab61f67fe4df76: The group has set out a long-term vision, “VISION 2030 – A Specialty Chemical Company Shining in the World,” designates “Environment,” “Healthcare” and “Electronics” as its strategic domains, and says it will expand products with the No.1 global share in raw materials for refrigeration oil, cosmetic raw materials and high-purity solvents, while creating new businesses and products. The 5th Medium-Term Management Plan, covering fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027, sets the basic policy as “Toward a New Growth Stage” and promotes three basic strategies: “Strengthening earning power,” “Laying the groundwork for the future” and “Strengthening the management foundation.”
entries.fd265b54790a2b21: Major customers including Idemitsu Kosan Co., Ltd. and Miyako Chemical Co., Ltd.
